operatorDesc.load_csv: Load time-series data from CSV/Excel files. Supports specifying timestamp column, value columns, encoding, and filtering by parent/child node IDs.
operatorDesc.row_filter: Filter data rows by conditions. Supports exact match (e.g., parent_id=park_01) and pandas expression filtering, preserving original column structure.
operatorDesc.resample_timeseries: Resample time-series data to a uniform time granularity (e.g., 15 minutes), auto-filling missing timestamps to generate a continuous time grid.
operatorDesc.detect_outliers: Detect outliers in time-series data. Supports Z-Score, IQR, and Isolation Forest methods, marking outliers as NaN for downstream filling. Uses only historical data to avoid future information leakage.
operatorDesc.handle_missing: Handle missing values (NaN) in time-series data. Supports linear interpolation, forward fill, backward fill, and mean fill, ensuring output data has no missing values.
operatorDesc.extract_time_features: Automatically extract time-related features (hour, day of week, month, etc.)
operatorDesc.holiday_features: Mark Chinese statutory holidays. Generates is_holiday and holiday_name columns, with option to exclude Spring Festival data.
operatorDesc.workday_features: Mark workdays and rest days. Generates is_workday column to distinguish workday and rest day electricity patterns.
operatorDesc.rolling_statistics: Calculate rolling statistical features: rolling mean, standard deviation, quantiles. Configurable window sizes (e.g., 24/48/96/168) to capture local trends and volatility.
operatorDesc.create_lag_features: Generate lag features: shift target column by specified steps (e.g., lag_1, lag_24, lag_168), using historical values as model input.
operatorDesc.sliding_window: Slice time-series data into model input samples using sliding windows. Window size determines how many historical data points form one input, step size controls offset between adjacent samples.
operatorDesc.train_test_split_ts: Split data into training and test sets in chronological order. Maintains time order without shuffling, supports split by ratio or specified date.
operatorDesc.multi_step_forecast: Configure multi-step forecast strategy: forecast steps (e.g., 96 steps = next 24 hours), strategy (recursive/direct/hybrid), time unit per step.
operatorDesc.xgboost_forecast: XGBoost gradient boosted tree prediction. Training mode trains model and returns predictions; prediction mode loads trained model for inference. Supports auto-tuning and sample weights.
operatorDesc.auto_tune_xgboost: Use Bayesian optimization to automatically search for optimal XGBoost hyperparameters (learning rate, tree depth, subsample rate, etc.) to improve model performance.
operatorDesc.smape_score: Calculate Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE), measuring deviation between predicted and actual values, range 0-200%, lower is better.
operatorDesc.mse_rmse_mae: Calculate three regression evaluation metrics simultaneously: MSE (Mean Squared Error), RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error), MAE (Mean Absolute Error) for comprehensive prediction accuracy assessment.
operatorDesc.load_database: Load data from relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite) by executing SQL queries.
operatorDesc.load_api: Fetch remote data via REST API, supporting GET/POST requests and custom headers.
operatorDesc.diff_features: Calculate difference features: first-order and seasonal differences to capture data change trends and seasonal patterns.
operatorDesc.pct_change_features: Calculate percentage change features, measuring relative change magnitude over specified periods.
operatorDesc.extract_statistical_features: Calculate historical statistical features: mean, max, min, standard deviation to capture long-term statistical patterns.
operatorDesc.peak_valley_features: Mark peak/valley periods: peak (high electricity usage), valley (low usage), flat periods, reflecting electricity pricing patterns.
operatorDesc.shift_features: Mark shift information: morning, afternoon, night shifts, reflecting different work shift electricity patterns.

algorithmAgent.preselectedSandboxWelcome:
Hi! I am **Sandbox Agent** (algorithm backtest assistant).

📌 **Preselected template**: {{templateName}} ({{templateTypeLabel}})

I will help you configure this backtest task. Please tell me:
1. **Dataset**: Which dataset do you want to use?
2. **Forecast horizon**: How long do you want to forecast? (e.g. day-ahead, week-ahead)
3. **Data frequency**: What is the time granularity? (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour)
4. **Algorithm parameters**: Do you want to adjust training settings? (e.g. epochs, learning rate)

You can describe your requirements directly, and I will guide the full setup.

welcome.curator:
Hi! I am **Curator Agent** (algorithm planning assistant).

I can help you:
• 🔍 Search the AI solution library and find the best-matching approach
• 📋 Recommend algorithm templates based on your business scenario
• 📊 Analyze dataset requirements and preparation direction
• ⚖️ Compare multiple options and provide professional advice

Describe your scenario or requirement, and I will help you find the best solution.

Hi! I am **Sandbox Agent** (algorithm backtest assistant).

I can help you:
• 📁 Guide dataset mounting and format checks

• 📈 Evaluate metrics (MAPE, RMSE, R², etc.)

If your dataset is ready, we can start validation now.
welcome.onboarding:
Hi! I am **Onboarding Agent** (deployment assistant).

I can help you:
• 🚀 Deploy trained models to production services
• ⏰ Configure recurring retraining schedules
• 🔌 Publish inference APIs for real-time prediction
• 📊 Monitor service health and runtime status

If training is complete, I can help you launch now.
welcome.operation:

I can help you:
• 📉 Detect accuracy drift and model degradation
• 🔍 Analyze root causes of performance decline
• 🤖 Select better models and trigger retraining
• ⚡ Tune models to recover and improve accuracy

I will help you keep online model performance stable.
